Closest thing I can ship now is the Hammer Thor P2, 10 TH/s at ~166W, $379 (down from $449), in stock: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/hammer-miner-thor-p2

Want me to flag the NerdOctaxe for you when it's back, or set up the Thor P2?
I have a Thor wanted another bsb octaxe

Understood, Eric. Then it's a wait, I'm afraid. The B. NerdOctaxe is out in all three plugs, and the plain NerdOctaxe and the hydro-cooled version are out too, so there's no second one I can sell you today.

I can ask Georges when the next BSB batch is landing and have him come back to you right here. Want me to do that?
